integrity: The connected Graph Atlas domain through seven vertices is checked with two independent shortest-path reconstructions. All centrality values use exact rational arithmetic, and every first-conflict orbit is verified by complete permutation checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected finite simple undirected graphs, standard unweighted closeness and harmonic centrality, and graph order at most seven. The exact finite domain is supplied by the documented Read--Wilson Graph Atlas. No larger-order frequency or classification is claimed.
title: Seven vertices are the sharp unique-leader split for closeness and harmonic centrality
